**Bring more to life.**
Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?
  
  
At Cytiva, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.
  
  
You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.
  
  
Working at Cytiva means being at the forefront of providing new solutions to transform human health. Our incredible customers undertake life-saving activities ranging from fundamental biological research to developing innovative vaccines, new medicines, and cell and gene therapies.
  
  
At Cytiva you will be able to continuously improve yourself and us – working on challenges that truly matter with people that care for each other, our customers, and their patients. Take your next step to an altogether life-changing career.
  
  
Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.
  
  
The Filtration Sales Specialist for Cytiva is responsible for territory growth, expansion of direct sales, establishment of professional relationships and meeting targets for profitable sales volume and margin dollars.
  
  
This role reports to the Northeast Eastern Canada USCAN Filtration Zone Leader and is part of the Resin, Filtration, and Media business unit. The position is remote and is responsible for covering the Northeast US (New England), Quebec and Eastern Provinces.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

- Contribute to sales strategies and account plans, as part of the core account team. Develop sales opportunities to create a sales funnel to meet business targets. Manage leads and prospects using customer relationship management software.
- Primarily focus on Filtration Consumables opportunities and surrounding single use designs within the territory, and supports all filtration consumables products, process related single use technologies and relevant equipment to support these processes. These responsibilities include both by providing the Account Manager in sales process with product expertise as well as independently identifying opportunities.
- Develop the sales of modality process solutions in the assigned sales region/territory, establishing long lasting technical customer relationships.
- Provide high level technical expertise during pre-sales discussions, instrument demonstrations, customer training, post-sales support, seminars, tenders/quotes, and promotional events.
- Lead technical and process related discussions with customer Subject Matter Experts and give applicative support including trouble shooting and answer customer queries of sophisticated technical and applicative nature.

**Who You Are**

- Bachelor’s degree in life sciences or relevant field
- 2+ plus years of hands-on experience with filtration and downstream processing preferred
- Strong communication skills – English written and spoken
- Problem solving skills applied to customer processes
- Data analysis – performance and sales trend reporting

**Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements**

- Ability to travel – 20 % travel, overnight, within territory or locations
- Must have a valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record
- Ability to lift, move or carry equipment up to 35lb, any other physical requirements

**It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:**

- GMP manufacturing experience
- Process development with knowledge of clinical workflow
- Commercial sales process, preferably in the Biotechnology industry.
- Cross selling, upselling, value positions and funnel management.

Cytiva, a Danaher operating company, offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefit programs that add value to our lives. Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programs contribute to life beyond the job. Check out our benefits at Danaher Benefits Info.
  
  
At Cytiva we believe in designing a better, more sustainable workforce. We recognize the benefits of flexible, remote working arrangements for eligible roles and are committed to providing enriching careers, no matter the work arrangement. This position is eligible for a remote work arrangement in which you can work remotely from your home. Additional information about this remote work arrangement will be provided by your interview team. Explore the flexibility and challenge that working for Cytiva can provide.
  
  
The salary range for this role is $100,000 - $130,000. This is the range that we in good faith believe is the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. This range may be modified in the future.
  
  
This job is also eligible for bonus/incentive pay.
  
  
We offer comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.
  
  
Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole discretion, consistent with the law.
  
  
Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.
  
  
For more information, visit www.danaher.com.
  
  
Danaher Corporation and all Danaher Companies are committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, color, national origin, religion, sex, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or other characteristics protected by law.
  
  
The U.S. EEO posters are available here.
  
  
For candidates who are based outside of New York City or who are applying for roles outside of New York City, for more information about conditions of any job offer please click here.
  
  
We comply with federal and state disability laws and make reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact:1-202-419-7762 or applyassistance@danaher.com.

## **The Mission**

As Director of Product Marketing, you define how SalesRabbit wins in the market. You translate a complex, multi-product portfolio across SalesRabbit, Roofle, RoofLink, RoofRabbit, financing, billing, and future platform capabilities into clear positioning and a differentiated commercial story. You establish who each product serves, why customers should choose it, and how the portfolio supports customer acquisition, adoption, and expansion.

You sit at the center of Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing, translating product strategy into commercial execution. You own positioning, messaging, product launch strategy, sales enablement and training, competitive intelligence, and customer adoption and expansion marketing. You lead Product Marketing’s contribution to pricing and packaging, bringing customer insight, value articulation, and commercial recommendations into decisions with Product, Finance, and go-to-market leadership.

You build the continuous launch and commercialization discipline required to bring an evolving portfolio to market. That includes defining the audience and value proposition, establishing go-to-market readiness, preparing sellers and customer-facing teams, coordinating launch execution, and measuring adoption after release. You also own the marketing strategy for upsell and cross-sell, identifying the customer needs, segments, use cases, and offers that create credible expansion opportunities.

You partner closely with Growth Marketing, which translates positioning and customer insight into acquisition campaigns, prospect lifecycle programs, ABM, and events. You work with Brand and Content to ensure storytelling and creative execution reflect the product’s value and differentiation. You partner deeply with Product to turn roadmap and product vision into commercialization plans that the broader organization can execute, while ensuring market feedback informs future decisions.

This is a highly hands-on leadership role. You will personally own critical Product Marketing work while building the team, processes, operating rhythms, and capabilities that allow the function to scale. You are responsible for ensuring customer, competitive, and market intelligence continuously informs how we position, launch, sell, and expand the portfolio. You must be able to challenge assumptions, resolve competing priorities, and align teams around a clear commercial direction.

You use AI to accelerate customer and market research, competitive intelligence, message testing, enablement, and execution while maintaining accuracy and sound judgment. Your success is measured by launch effectiveness, seller readiness, win rates, sales velocity, product adoption, competitive performance, and the conversion and revenue contribution of customer expansion programs.

## **Who We Are**

Sales Rabbit is a software company built for roofing and field sales. It builds the tools contractors and reps use at the door, in the office, and on the job: to generate demand, sell, operate, and get paid. Those tools run from the first lead to the final payment, so the job doesn't get lost in between. They're designed to help contractors maximize their efficiency. We build software solutions that propel our customers' businesses forward: Roof Rabbit for roofing and Field Rabbit for everything else sold door-to-door.

Everything runs as one unified, AI-native platform, in a single flow from lead to cash. Our solution brings together AI canvassing, online estimates, instant quotes, territory mapping, scheduling, communication, weather data, proposals, financing, measurements, project management, material ordering, inspections, and payments.

We believe speed decides who wins in the field, and that belief changes how we build and operate. As a distributed team, we focus on moving faster, operating with greater agility, and using AI and automation as practical force multipliers. Our goal is simple: help contractors grow more efficiently while building a company that can learn, innovate, and deliver value faster.

## **What You’ll Own**

### **Portfolio Positioning and Commercial Strategy**

- Own positioning and messaging across products, bundles, audiences, and lifecycle stages.
- Define the relationship between individual product value propositions and the broader platform story, ensuring claims reflect actual capabilities and integration readiness.
- Establish who should buy each product, why it is differentiated, and when an upgrade, cross-sell, or migration creates value.
- Own Product Marketing’s commercialization strategy and contribute to the integrated company go-to-market plan.
- Develop a clear market point of view that helps buyers understand the problems we solve and why our approach is different.
- Partner on pricing and packaging through customer research, value insights, packaging recommendations, and ROI narratives.

### **Customer and Competitive Intelligence**

- Own Voice of Customer and market intelligence across customer discovery, win/loss analysis, buyer sentiment, competitive movement, adoption data, and field feedback.
- Translate research into specific recommendations that influence positioning, product decisions, launches, and commercial priorities.
- Establish a repeatable competitive intelligence program that equips customer-facing teams and informs leadership.
- Partner with Product throughout the lifecycle to validate customer value, positioning, and commercial readiness.
- Identify gaps between what customers need, what the product delivers, and how the company describes its value.

### **Product Launches and Commercialization**

- Own launch strategy and go-to-market readiness across new products, significant releases, and portfolio changes.
- Define launch audiences, value propositions, messaging, offers, enablement requirements, adoption plans, and success measures.
- Build a repeatable launch discipline with clear responsibilities, dependencies, milestones, and post-launch reviews.
- Coordinate execution across Product, Growth Marketing, Brand and Content, Sales, and Customer Success.
- Surface readiness gaps early and recommend changes to scope, sequencing, or launch plans.
- Measure adoption and commercial performance after launch and use the findings to improve subsequent execution.

Product owns product and release readiness. Product Marketing owns the commercial readiness required to introduce, sell, and support the offering.

### **Sales Enablement and Training**

- Build the enablement system that gives Sales clear messaging, demos, tools, competitive intelligence, and launch support.
- Own product and sales training, including value articulation, discovery support, use cases, objection handling, and competitive positioning.
- Establish seller proficiency expectations and assess whether training improves readiness and effectiveness.
- Keep enablement current as products, customer needs, and competitive conditions change.
- Partner with Sales leadership to reinforce adoption, coaching, and use of materials in live opportunities.

### **Customer Adoption and Expansion**

- Own the marketing strategy for customer adoption, upsell, cross-sell, and advocacy.
- Define eligible customer segments, expansion use cases, triggers, offers, messaging, and campaign plans.
- Partner with Customer Success to identify needs and opportunities and with Sales or account management to support assisted expansion.
- Build customer education, communications, references, and advocacy programs that strengthen adoption and commercial credibility.
- Evaluate total portfolio performance so growth in one product does not obscure lost value elsewhere.

Sales or account management owns assisted closing. Product and Customer Success share responsibility for adoption and retention.

### **Team Leadership and Operating Discipline**

- Establish the function before the full team is in place, then sequence the hiring of a Product Marketing Manager and a Customer Marketing Manager.
- Set priorities and standards for research, messaging, launches, enablement, and expansion programs.
- Personally lead the most consequential work while developing the team’s judgment and execution capabilities.
- Use specialist support deliberately where it adds expertise or capacity.
- Embed practical AI workflows across research, competitive intelligence, analysis, message development, and enablement.
- Communicate recommendations clearly and hold cross-functional teams to agreed launch and commercial commitments.

## **What We Are Looking For**

### **Required**

- 8+ years in B2B SaaS Product Marketing, with deep hands-on ownership of positioning, launches, enablement, customer insight, and commercialization.
- Experience building or significantly transforming Product Marketing in a high-growth environment.
- Demonstrated success establishing a repeatable launch and release discipline across multiple products or a rapidly evolving platform.
- A record of measurable impact on launch adoption, seller effectiveness, win rates, sales velocity, expansion, or revenue growth.
- Exceptional ability to translate complex products and technical capabilities into simple, differentiated customer value.
- Meaningful pricing and packaging experience, including research, value articulation, ROI narratives, and commercial recommendations.
- Experience positioning multiple products within a coherent portfolio or platform story.
- Demonstrated ownership of customer discovery, competitive research, win/loss analysis, and market validation.
- Experience designing and delivering product or sales training, with evidence that sellers used the work and improved their readiness or effectiveness.
- Experience developing upsell or cross-sell plays through customer segmentation, usage insights, and partnership with Sales and Customer Success.
- Proven ability to influence senior Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and executive stakeholders in ambiguous environments.
- Ability to hire and develop talent, establish operating discipline, and personally execute high-impact work.
- Practical use of AI across research, competitive intelligence, analysis, messaging, enablement, and execution, with repeatable workflows you can demonstrate.

**Preferred**

- Experience in roofing, home services, construction technology, or field sales.
- Experience integrating acquired products into a coherent portfolio story.
- Experience commercializing products through both sales-led and product-led growth motions.
- Experience in founder-led, private-equity-backed, or significant transformation environments.

## **What Success Looks Like**

### Within the first six months:

- Clear positioning defines who each product serves, why it wins, and how it relates to the rest of the portfolio.
- Priority launches have documented audiences, messaging, readiness criteria, enablement, adoption plans, and measurement.
- Sellers have current materials and demonstrate proficiency in the product story, customer value, and priority objections.
- Customer and competitive insights regularly inform product and commercial decisions.
- Expansion audiences and plays are defined, with initial programs launched and measured.
- A phased hiring plan establishes clear responsibilities for Product Marketing and Customer Marketing.

### **KPIs**

- Launch adoption among intended customer segments.
- Launch readiness and milestone delivery.
- Seller readiness and proficiency.
- Enablement usage in relevant opportunities.
- Targeted win-rate and sales-velocity trends.
- Expansion-qualified opportunities.
- Expansion-play conversion and revenue contribution.

Revenue, adoption, and retention are shared business outcomes. Product Marketing is accountable for its contribution, with numerical targets established from the baseline and commercial plan.

## **Who Thrives Here**

At SalesRabbit, we hire for operating cadence and mindset. The people who do best here share a few things in common:

- Active Curiosity - You seek root causes before proposing solutions and stay ahead of industry trends and tools.
- Grit & Scrappiness - You roll up your sleeves on hard, ambiguous, unglamorous work. You build functions, systems, messaging, and operating models before asking for additional headcount or resources.
- Extreme Ownership - You take accountability for outcomes, proactively communicate blockers, and deliver with minimal oversight.
- Bias Toward Impact - You measure success by business outcome, not effort. You course-correct fast and without ego.
- Team-First Collaboration - You listen to understand, give credit generously, and push back when something is wrong - to protect the outcome, not win the argument. You create clarity where none exists.

## **Benefits**

- 20 days of PTO + 10 paid holidays
- Medical, Vision, Dental, Life Insurance
- 401(k) 100% matching up to 4% of salary
- Company phone plan covering service for employee and spouse/child

*SalesRabbit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law.*

**Job Title:**
Senior Technical Specialist - Life Science
  
  
**Location:**
Boston MA Greater Area
  
  
**Location Type:**
Remote
  
  
**Website:**
https://www.wmfts.com/en/
  
  
**Group:**
https://www.spiraxgroup.com/
  
  
When you join Watson-Marlow Fluid Technology Solutions, a part of the Spirax Group, you will be integrated into a cooperative and encouraging team, participate in challenging yet critical work, and experience ongoing growth opportunities to help you achieve your full potential. Visit our website to learn more.
  
  
**Company Overview**
At Watson-Marlow Fluid Technology Solutions, part of Spirax Group, we are driven by innovation and are dedicated to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone is empowered to make a difference. As a world leader in manufacturing peristaltic pumps and associated fluid path technologies for the life sciences and process industries, we offer a wide range of products, including tubing, specialised filling systems and products for single-use applications.
  
  
Our shared Purpose is to create sustainable value for all our stakeholders as we engineer a more efficient, safer and sustainable world. Our technologies play an essential role in critical industrial processes and industrial equipment across industries as diverse as Food & Beverage, Pharmaceutical & Biotechnology, Power Generation, Semiconductors and Healthcare. With customers in 116 countries, we provide the solutions that sit behind the production of many items used in daily life, from baked beans to mobile phones!
  
  
Our inclusive culture and Values, unites us, guides our decisions and inspires us everywhere that we operate. We support our colleagues to make their difference for each other as well as customers, communities, suppliers, our planet and shareholders by creating a truly equitable working environment where everyone feels included.
  
  
**Why Join Us**

- Work on high-impact, technically complex solutions across global industries
- Be part of a collaborative, people-first culture with strong internal mobility
- Access career growth and development opportunities, including leadership pathways
- Contribute to a company committed to inclusion, innovation, and sustainability

**This Role Will Focus On**
As the Senior Technical Specialist (STS) for Watson-Marlow Fluid Technology Solutions, you will play a key leadership role in driving the growth and success of our overall customer experience in the USA by delivering world class technical support. Reporting to the Vice President of Life Sciences, you will work collaboratively with the local sales and operational teams to deliver exceptional customer solutions, support large projects, and strengthen partnerships with key customers. You will serve as an authority on product specification, project management, customer application solutions, and factory customization capabilities of each brand while ensuring technical resources on the operation team are fit for purpose to serve the life science market.
  
  
The primary responsibility of the STS will be to work with all functional groups throughout the Life Sciences division to help define, develop, and drive our technical expertise and engineering support structure. This role will be expected to build a strong network of key contacts within the engineering/design teams of our key customers, engineering firms, and consultancies. The STS will have responsibility for training these contacts on the unique technical value propositions to help influence their recommendations to their customers for specifying WMFTS products.
  
  
STS is expected to intimately know the technical capabilities of all WMFTS engineering resources, both local and global. You will remain up-to-date with on all developments related to products, services, and procedures to help WM Inc deliver unmatched service quality while ensuring compliance with regulatory standards.
  
  
In this high-impact role, you will also act as a thought leader, representing Watson-Marlow at industry events, building relationships with decision-makers, and serving as the authority on large project negotiations while aligning with the long-term goals of both our clients and the organization.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**
**Large Project Technical Lead:**
Serve as the primary technical contact and facilitate the deliverables for both local and global large projects. Duties include creation and maintenance of documentation relating to the project, along with coordinating project expectations with the customer and WMFTS resources to help ensure all commitments are delivered on time.
  
  
**Technical Expertise:**
Be the recognised company expert in emerging technical trends, regulatory compliance, complimentary products, and competitive product capabilities to help inform our sales team on how to better position WMFTS products with their customers.
  
  
**Innovation and Improvement:**
Drive innovation by identifying gaps in our technical service portfolio and implementing best practices to improve the customer impact of WMFTS resources.Work with WMFTS factories to support customer requests for customization, testing requirements, and validating outcomes.Lead local support for new product innovation initiatives.
  
  
**Training and Support:**
Collaborate with the local sales, operations teams, and key customers to improve their overall technical knowledge through regular training sessions and field support.This includes onsite customer training, certified customer training, and supporting internal employee training opportunities.
  
  
**Strategic Planning:**
Collaborate with Application Engineering leadership to develop and implement annual strategic plans for delivering our engineering solutions to the market using available operations resources and factory support.Help manage customer expectations by clearly defining our capability and capacity to support customers to all internal stakeholders.
  
  
**Relationship Building:**
Build and maintain relationships with key industry contacts by understanding their needs and aligning our technical resources to provide solutions more effectively.
  
  
**Risk Management:**
Identify and mitigate risks associated with engineering and technical support, ensuring business continuity and long-term success.
  
  
**Networking:**
Attend and/or present at conferences and exhibitions to network and meet new contacts, expanding our reach and identifying potential business opportunities.
  
  
**Health & Safety:**
Ensure the business provides a consistently safe working environment for all colleagues, drive health and safety improvements, and monitor EHS performance.
  
  
**Governance:**
Comply with all aspect of the Spirax Group policies and procedure.
  
  
**Who You’ll Be Working With**
The Strategic Accounts function is pivotal to the continued delivery of services to our major customers. Success within this function requires strong partnership with our local Sales teams, Strategic Account peers in other locations.
  
  
**This is what you’ll need to be successful in this role**

- Strong knowledge of key customers and processes and applications within the Life Sciences sector including an expert understanding of the industry and market dynamics.
- Significant commercial management and Sales experience including Key Account or Large Customer management experience of large complex, global or multi-regional accounts.
- Contract reviews/negotiation experience and awareness of contractual principles and risks.
- Proven ability to lead, grow and develop high performance teams, Ideally in a regional role.
- Ability to generate followership across regional, multifunctional departments; ideally within a similar corporate organisation.
- Cultural and regional awareness with the ability to work across countries and cultures, ideally working with a similar multinational manufacturer.

**Physical Demands**
Mobility: This is a remote position that primarily requires sitting at a desk or computer workstation for extended periods, with occasional need to stand or move around to maintain health and well-being. Ability to regularly operate a computer keyboard and mouse.
  
  
Vision and Hearing: Ability to use a computer and read documents. Effective communication skills to interact with colleagues and clients through video conferencing tools.
  
  
Dexterity: Basic hand dexterity for typing and using computer peripherals
  
  
Reasonable accommodations will be provided to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions.
  
  
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
  
  
This position offers a salary range of USD 104,076.00 - 156,115.00 per year. Final salary offers are determined by multiple factors, including education, experience, internal equity, geographic location, and the candidate’s expertise, and therefore may vary from the range listed. For roles based outside Massachusetts, the applicable salary range may be lower.
  
  
**At Watson-Marlow, we believe in taking care of our colleagues. We offer a generous benefits package, including:**

- Robust Retirement Plan: Benefit from a 5% employer 401K contribution, plus a 50% match on up to 3% of your contributions for added financial security, empowering your financial security.
- Comprehensive and Supportive Parental Leave: Experience our inclusive, gender-neutral parental leave policy, offering 16 weeks at 100% pay. **Job Summary:**

We are seeking a Customer Success Manager (CSM) to join our team and help ensure our customers derive maximum value from our products and services. As a Customer Success Manager, you will serve as the main point of contact for a portfolio of clients and play a key role in guiding customers from post-sale onboarding through go-live, product adoption, and long-term success. This role is responsible for helping customers achieve their business goals, driving effective onboarding and implementation milestones, and ultimately ensuring customer satisfaction and retention.

The ideal candidate will possess a combination of excellent interpersonal skills, a strong customer-focused mindset, and the ability to proactively address challenges. This role is essential in fostering long-term relationships, identifying growth opportunities, and acting as the customer’s advocate within the organization.

This role also carries direct responsibility for managing newly onboarding customers through a structured onboarding process, including GUIDEcx project coordination, milestone tracking, weekly customer check-ins, go-live readiness, and follow-up on open action items to ensure a smooth transition into long-term customer success.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

- Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned customers, building strong relationships and delivering a consistent, responsive customer experience from onboarding through ongoing account management.
- Guide newly onboarding customers through structured onboarding and implementation workflows, including GUIDEcx project coordination, milestone tracking, weekly customer check-ins, go-live readiness, documentation of next steps, and timely follow-up on open action items.
- Partner with Sales, Learning, Operations, Support, Product, Accounting, and business leadership to coordinate customer handoffs, resolve customer needs, and support timely follow-through on actions that contribute to customer satisfaction and retention.
- Monitor customer health, product adoption, account activity, and customer requests to identify potential retention risks, adoption barriers, or opportunities to improve the customer experience.
- Participate in periodic account health reviews with customers and internal stakeholders by helping document risks, opportunities, and follow-up actions.
- Support renewal and contract calendar management by tracking key dates, identifying upcoming customer or internal actions, and coordinating with responsible stakeholders.
- Coordinate customer issues that require support beyond standard troubleshooting by gathering relevant information, clarifying urgency and impact, and engaging the appropriate internal resources.

- Support customer cancellation, transfer-of-ownership, and administrative account-change requests by collecting required information, coordinating with internal stakeholders, and following established documentation, approval, and handoff processes.
- Maintain accurate records of customer communications, onboarding progress, account changes, approvals, effective dates, issue outcomes, and final resolutions in applicable systems.

- Solid problem-solving skills and the ability to address customer concerns with empathy and professionalism.
- Ability to recognize customer risk, summarize account trends, communicate next steps clearly, and work with cross-functional partners to resolve customer needs.

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

# **A Day in the Life**

We are seeking a committed professional to join our team. While this is a remote position not located at a physical Medtronic site, the candidate hired will be required to reside within the territory and drive to multiple accounts throughout the region. A valid driver's license is essential for this role.

As one of three comprehensive portfolios at Medtronic, Neuroscience is dedicated to improving the lives of people living with neurological disorders, spine conditions, and chronic pain. Guided by our Mission—to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life—we develop technologies and therapies that help people regain function, reduce pain, and return to the activities that matter most.

Our Cranial & Spinal Technologies (CST) Operating Unit develops and delivers an integrated ecosystem of spinal implants, navigation and robotic guidance systems, advanced imaging, and data-driven planning tools for complex spine and cranial procedures. Platforms such as AiBLE™ connect these technologies to enhance surgical precision, streamline workflows, and support improved patient outcomes across the globe.

Check us out on LinkedIn: [Medtronic CST](https://www.linkedin.com/company/medtronic-brain-and-spine-therapies/posts/?feedView=all)

Explore our AiBLE product portfolio for spinal and cranial procedures [here](https://www.medtronic.com/en-us/healthcare-professionals/specialties/spinal-cranial-orthopedic/therapies-procedures/technology-ai-driven-surgery/aible-smart-ecosystem/product-portfolio.html) .

Within the Cranial & Spinal Technologies (CST) Operating Unit, the AiBLE Strategic Sales Representative partners closely with sales leadership, surgeons, hospital stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to drive adoption and execution of Medtronic AiBLE platforms and strategic initiatives across the region. This role serves as a key commercial and clinical liaison responsible for supporting complex technology integration, procedural optimization, and long-term account development strategies. This individual will lead strategic technology initiatives focused on robotic-assisted surgery, navigation, advanced imaging, digital workflows, implants, biologics and enabling technologies that support spine procedures.

This is a **field-based** role.

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:

- Promotes and sells Medtronic's Cranial & Spinal Technologies AiBLE products and services within an assigned geographic area and /or specific customer accounts to meet or exceed sales targets.

- Build relationships with spine surgeons, administrators, OR leadership, procurement teams, and executive stakeholders
- Assist with technology evaluations, ROI justification, and value-based selling initiatives
- Coordinate and support surgeon education programs, cadaver labs, technology demonstrations, and customer training events
- Identify workflow efficiencies and procedural optimization opportunities that improve customer experience and patient outcomes
- Collaborate with marketing, training, operations, and clinical teams to ensure successful implementation and ongoing support
- Analyze regional performance metrics, utilization trends, and customer adoption data to drive strategic decision making
- Provide field intelligence and customer feedback to leadership and product development teams
- Travel extensively throughout assigned geography to support customer and business needs

# **Qualifications**

## **Must Have: Minimum Requirements**

*To be considered for this role, please ensure the minimum requirements are evident in your applicant profile.*

- High School Diploma (or equivalent) and 8+ years of relevant sales, clinical, or related experience in medical device, Medtech, healthcare or life sciences; or
- Associates Degree and 6+ years of relevant sales, clinical, or related experience in medical device, Medtech, healthcare or life sciences; or
- Bachelor's Degree and 4+ years of relevant sales, clinical, or related experience in medical device, Medtech, healthcare or life sciences.

## **Nice to Haves: Preferences**

- Experience supporting spine, neurosurgery, orthopedic, or robotic-assisted surgical procedures
- Strong understanding of Spine procedural workflows, operating room dynamics, and healthcare economics
- Operating room and sterile field experience strongly preferred
- Experience working directly with surgeons and hospital clinical teams
- Strong technical troubleshooting and customer-facing communication skills
- Ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities in a fast-paced field environment
- Experience with Biologics

**Additional Requirements:**

- Ability to travel extensively within assigned territory
- Ability to work in hospital and operating room environments
- Ability to stand for extended periods during surgical procedures
- Ability to lift and transport equipment up to 50 pounds
- Must possess a valid driver's license and active vehicle insurance policy.

Note: Your driving record will be reviewed and will be considered as part of your application.

For Baccalaureate degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree that satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R. § 214.2(h)(4)(iii)(A) is required.

Roles below the Principal level require candidates to possess unrestricted U.S. work authorization at the time of hire and for the duration of employment.

**Job description**

As a valuable member of a collaborative and engaged dental implant regional sales team, the successful candidate in this position will perform all field sales functions in their designated territory, including the development and maintenance of long-term professional relationships with potential and current clients, soliciting and securing orders for their business use. In partnership with a team of Inside Sales and Customer Support representatives, communicate product information and features that will enhance client knowledge and confidence. Forecast future sales and prepare periodic reports as required, recording activity and opportunity in CRM system.

  
  

**ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES:**

- Solidify customer relationships as a trusted, consultative business advisor and partner. Probe and identify customer’s business initiatives and needs, develop account plans to support growth, provide implementation support to increase product utilization.
- Increase market share through conversion of business clients to Implant Direct from competitors.
- Build and maintain an active sales funnel. Prospect, qualify and close new business opportunities, including cross-sell opportunities with current customers.
- Manage territory like a business. Prepare and execute territory business plan to ensure sustainable growth to meet or exceed monthly, quarterly and annual sales goal achievement.
- Pre-plan and align account penetration strategy with Inside Sales and Special Markets partners.
- Participate in tradeshows, educational offerings and other customer training and showcase events.
- Record sales activity and client information in CRM. Provide periodic and timely activity reports, including expenses, assessments, account gains/losses, competitor activity, etc.

**Job requirements**

**EDUCATION and EXPERIENCE:**

  

- Bachelor’s Degree strongly preferred
- 3 years of consultative B2B sales experience selling complex products and solutions with a track record of sales goal achievement
- 2 years Dental Implant experience strongly preferred.

- Proficiency in professional selling and influencing skills and account management
- Strong verbal and written communication skills required.
- Ability to execute strong time management and prioritization skills for optimal productivity.
- Frequent travel (approximately 50%) and possession of a valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record are required.
